exposure: Referral to physical therapy, psychotherapy, or pain specialists
outcome: Prevalence of opioid use before, during, and after pregnancy
cohort: 11,565 deliveries among 9,690 unique women aged 10 to 50 years
finding: Significant opioid use was associated with several risk factors, and while opioid use decreased from 2006 to 2014, it remained prevalent, highlighting the need for interventions to reduce opioid prescribing in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Significant opioid use was associated with Cesarean section.
